high_level_description: Man: Wearing a dark blue tracksuit with multiple logos, including "TAG HEUER," "Mobil 1," "Oracle," and "Honda." The tracksuit also features the Red Bull Racing logo prominently on the chest. He is wearing a matching dark blue cap with the Oracle Red Bull Racing logo. He has short hair and is smiling at the camera. He is holding a can of Red Bull in his right hand. Woman: Wearing a stylish tiger-print blazer in beige and black, paired with a black skirt. She is wearing a white cap with the Red Bull logo. She has long blonde hair and is smiling at the camera.
